report_comment.text: FIP1L1 encodes a component of the messenger RNA cleavage and polyadenylation machinery. PDGFRA encodes platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha, a receptor tyrosine kinase. FIP1L1::PDGFRA is a recognized fusion in myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with tyrosine-kinase gene fusions, often associated with eosinophilia. Imatinib can induce durable hematologic, cytogenetic and molecular remissions in FIP1L1::PDGFRA-associated myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms.
